title: Approval workflows
body: The order of approvals for each kind of request. Saving creates a new version: requests in progress keep the old one, new requests use this one.
confirmBody: This change takes effect as a new version. Requests already in progress keep the previous version's stages until they finish; only requests opened after this uses the new stage list.

rule.duty: A teacher on a given duty

stage.dutySlugHint: The teacher on this duty at the time approves.
stage.keyHint: How the system recognises this stage. Filled in from the name for a new stage.
stage.keyDuplicate: Another stage already uses this code.

stagesHint: Run in order from the top. Open a stage to change it.
emptyBody: Add the first stage: who approves and how.
summaryHint: Who approves at each stage and how, following your changes.
summaryEmpty: This flow has no stages yet.
stagesRequired: A flow needs at least one stage.
keysInvalid: A stage code is empty or used twice. Check the open stages.
unsaved: Changes to the {kind} flow are not saved yet
discardBody: Unsaved changes to the {kind} flow will be lost.
